mspellcompat.gui.title: MSpell Compatibility Suite Settings
mspellcompat.gui.weather.local_refill: Use local Simple Clouds rain for water refill
mspellcompat.gui.weather.local_refill.to: Use precipitation at the water's position instead of vanilla's global rain flag when Flowing Fluids refills finite water.
mspellcompat.gui.weather.create_surface_: Create thin water layers on wet surfaces
Allow the compatibility module to occasionally create a thin Flowing Fluids water layer on exposed solid surfaces during local rain.
Lower values create surface water more often. 1 is every eligible sample; 1200 is the conservative default.
mspellcompat.gui.weather.surface_units: Units in a new surface-water layer
mspellcompat.gui.weather.surface_units.t: Amount of Flowing Fluids water to create, from 1 to 8 units.
mspellcompat.gui.lso.drinking: Consume finite water when drinking by hand
mspellcompat.gui.lso.drinking.tooltip: When enabled, a successful LSO drink from a world water block consumes the configured amount of Flowing Fluids water.
mspellcompat.gui.lso.units_per_drink.too: How many Flowing Fluids units are removed after an eligible successful drink.
mspellcompat.gui.lso.canteen: Consume finite water when filling a canteen
mspellcompat.gui.lso.canteen.tooltip: When enabled, filling an LSO canteen from a Flowing Fluids water block removes a unit from that block. Cauldron handling is unchanged.
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.count_partial_wat: Treat partial Flowing Fluids water as adjacent water
Allow Burnt Basic's adjacent-water check to recognize the Flowing Fluids fluid state, including partial volumes.
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.minimum_amount: Minimum water amount for extinguishing checks
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.minimum_amount.to: Minimum amount (1–8) a neighboring Flowing Fluids water block must contain to count as water.
mspellcompat.config.use_local_precipitat: Use local Simple Clouds precipitation for finite-water refill
mspellcompat.config.create_surface_water: Create thin water layers from local rain
mspellcompat.config.consume_finite_water: Consume finite water when filling a canteen
mspellcompat.config.count_flowing_fluids: Count partial Flowing Fluids water as adjacent water
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.local_rain: Require local Simple Clouds rain to extinguish fire
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.local_rain.toolti: Require actual Simple Clouds rain at the fire position for Burnt Basic’s rain-extinguishing path. This does not change adjacent-water logic.
mspellcompat.gui.diagnostics.debug_loggi: Write detailed MSpellCompat diagnostics to the log. Enable only while investigating a problem; fluid tick tracing can generate large logs.
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.layers_consumed: Water layers consumed per extinguished block
mspellcompat.gui.burnt.layers_consumed.t: Water units removed from an adjacent Flowing Fluids water block for each Burnt Basic extinguish. 0 disables consumption. If no adjacent water block has enough units, it cannot extinguish the block.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.enabled: Enable splash creation and water displacement
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.enabled.to: Enables handling of moving Sable structures overlapping Flowing Fluids water.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.minimum_ma: Structures below this aggregate mass are skipped. Sable Beyond mass integration is used when enabled below.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.minimum_sp: Structures moving slower than this value do not create splashes.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.splash_rad: Radius of free cells around the waterline. Higher mass and speed can increase it, up to 8 blocks.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.max_source: Maximum source water blocks per event
Limits the number of water blocks removed during one overlap event.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.units_per_: Caps how many Flowing Fluids units can be placed in one free cell.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.max_units_: Global cap on water placed by the handler during one game tick.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.cooldown.t: Delay between displacement attempts for the same dynamic structure.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.max_events: Limits the number of structures processed during one game tick.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.water_loss: Fraction of displaced water not recreated as splashes. 0 preserves all volume; 100 creates no splashes.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.displace_s: Allows source water blocks to be processed. If disabled, typical water sources are skipped and will not create splashes.
mspellcompat.gui.sable_impact.use_sable_: Use the extended aggregate mass reader when Sable Beyond is installed.
